workItems.title: Data Analysis & Automation Consultant
workItems.shortDescription: Transformed regulatory data into actionable insights for 10,000+ charitable organizations
workItems.detailedStory: Six-year engagement processing and analyzing large-scale regulatory datasets for Canada's charitable sector. Progressed from SQL analysis to implementing machine learning models for compliance pattern recognition.
workItems.explorationContent:
### The Challenge

Canadian charities submit complex regulatory filings with inconsistent data quality across 86,000+ organizations. Manual processing couldn't scale with sector growth or regulatory changes.

### The Evolution

**Year 1-2**: Manual SQL queries and statistical analysis. Identified repeatable patterns in data errors and validation requirements.

**Year 3-4**: Developed Python scripts for automation. Reduced processing time from weeks to days. First applications of pattern recognition.

**Year 5-6**: Implemented ML models for anomaly detection and predictive compliance. Transitioned from reactive analysis to proactive insight generation.

### The Impact

- Published sector-wide analyses reaching 10,000+ organizations annually
- Processing time reduced from weeks to hours through automation
- Created frameworks now standard across the firm
- Work cited in academic research and policy documents

### Recognition

**Academic Citations:**
- [Carleton University Research Note (2023)](https://carleton.ca/profbrouard/wp-content/uploads/PARGnote202439RNRegisteredcharitiesstatistics20240111FBML.pdf)
- [Carleton T3010 Research Group (2025)](https://carleton.ca/profbrouard/t3010researchgroup/)

**Media Coverage:**
- [Hilborn Charity eNEWS (2024)](https://hilborn-charityenews.ca/articles/data-snapshot-the-canadian-charity-sector-2022)
- [The Charity Report (2021)](https://www.thecharityreport.com/features/blumberg-snapshot/)
- [Foundation Magazine (2022)](https://foundationmag.ca/how-much-did-the-largest-canadian-private-foundations-spend-in-2020/)

**Policy Influence:**
- [Alberta Public Inquiry Report (2020)](https://open.alberta.ca/dataset/3176fd2d-670b-4c4a-b8a7-07383ae43743/resource/f8a8d0ff-24c1-427f-9989-f24283f75cd2/download/energy-report-public-inquiry-anti-alberta-energy-campaigns-sched-g-tax-memorandum.pdf)

workItems.title: Dormezy - Student Housing Platform
workItems.shortDescription: Founded venture-backed startup selected for WebSummit presentation
workItems.detailedStory: Identified critical inefficiency in $200B student housing market. Built platform combining verified listings, virtual tours, and integrated lease signing. Secured funding and prestigious accelerator placement.
workItems.explorationContent:
### Market Insight

Student housing platforms hadn't evolved with user expectations. Fragmented listings, unverified properties, no integrated lease signing. Technology existed to solve each problem—nobody had combined them effectively.

### Execution

- Secured $30,000 in seed funding
- Built comprehensive platform: verified listings, virtual tours, roommate matching
- Selected from 2,400+ startups for WebSummit Alpha program
- 500+ students joined beta within 2 months
- 12 property partners committed pre-launch

### Key Learning

Working with traditional developers revealed systemic inefficiencies: inflated timelines, artificial complexity, vendor lock-in. This experience directly informed my transition to AI-powered development—understanding both the problem and the solution.

workItems.title: Phoebus Digital - Development Studio
workItems.shortDescription: AI-powered development delivering in days what traditionally takes weeks
workItems.detailedStory: Development studio specializing in rapid, AI-native solutions. Focus on education technology and platforms requiring fast, reliable execution.
workItems.explorationContent:
### Philosophy

Traditional development treats clients like car owners at a dishonest mechanic—technical opacity enables exploitation. My approach: transparent pricing, guaranteed delivery, complete ownership transfer.

### Process Innovation

**Specification First**: Clear requirements before code
**Fixed Deliverables**: Product, not service model
**Rapid Iteration**: 1-2 day delivery through AI-powered development
**Complete Transfer**: Client owns everything outright

### Results

- ApplyVisa: 40,000+ programs, zero external cost
- EnglishUnleashed: 600,000 users in 4 months
- L2English: Complete IELTS platform with Cambridge integration

Each project rebuilt 3-4 times as development approach evolved—from week-long manual coding to 1-2 day spec-driven delivery.

workItems.title: ApplyVisa.au
workItems.shortDescription: Australia's most comprehensive education search platform
workItems.detailedStory: Transformed stalled project into functioning platform at zero external cost. Built searchable database of 40,000+ programs from CRICOS government data. Now the primary research tool for Australian education.
workItems.explorationContent:
### Client Situation

Commission agreements with universities in place. Previous developers quoted $50,000+ with uncertain delivery. Existing competitors prioritized conversion over utility—incomplete data, aggressive sales funnels.

### Strategic Approach

Rather than compete on marketing spend, become the definitive research tool:

- Scraped complete CRICOS government database
- Built comprehensive, filterable interface
- Session persistence without account requirements
- SEO-optimized pages for every university and field
- Utility-first design drives natural conversion

### Technical Execution

- Zero external costs (no API fees, scraped public data)
- 3-week delivery from concept to launch
- Complete client ownership of code and data
- Scalable architecture handling thousands of daily searches

### Market Impact

Became the most comprehensive free resource for Australian education research. Commission structure means superior user experience aligns with business model—helping students find the right program drives revenue.

workItems.title: EnglishUnleashed
workItems.shortDescription: Language learning platform reaching 600,000+ users organically
workItems.detailedStory: Evolved linguistics professor's concept from PDF store to comprehensive platform. Strategic guidance prevented premature scaling while achieving viral growth through AI-generated content.
workItems.explorationContent:
### Evolution Through Validation

**Week 1 - MVP**: Simple PDF store using Gumroad API. YouTube integration for video catalog. Zero backend complexity. Test market response before building.

**Month 2 - Viral Growth**: AI-generated shadowing videos gained 200,000 subscribers. Key insight: the 'soulless' AI voice was perfect for learners—clear, consistent, comprehensible. What entertainment considers a weakness, education considers a strength.

**Month 4 - Platform Scaling**: 
- Migrated from Gumroad (reducing 10% fees to 2.9%)
- Built quiz system with progress tracking
- Implemented tiered subscriptions
- Account system capturing user value

### Strategic Guidance

Client wanted to add mobile app and AI chat immediately. Advised against—validate core offering first. Features without proven value create maintenance burden, not competitive advantage.

### Results

- 600,000 users in 4 months
- Sustainable revenue from day one
- Complete platform ownership
- Positioned for strategic expansion based on data, not assumptions

workItems.title: L2English
workItems.shortDescription: IELTS certification platform with Cambridge integration
workItems.detailedStory: Collaboration platform connecting certified teachers with IELTS students. Clean architecture focused on core value: effective test preparation.
workItems.explorationContent:
### Design Principle

No feature bloat. Every element serves the core mission: preparing students for IELTS certification.

### Core Platform

- **Cambridge Integration**: Official placement testing
- **Flexible Structure**: Group and individual instruction tiers
- **Progress Analytics**: Data-driven improvement tracking
- **Material Distribution**: Centralized resource management
- **Clean Architecture**: Focus on learning, not platform complexity

### Technical Implementation

- Real-time video sessions without third-party dependencies
- Stripe subscription management with sandbox testing
- Complete client ownership of infrastructure
- Production-ready with single webhook configuration

### Value Delivery

Platform does one thing excellently: connect qualified teachers with motivated students for IELTS success. No distractions, no unnecessary features, just effective preparation.
